scope: Five redesigned covers for the eight Fujifilm capture presets; retain three approved covers; collection Library untouched

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: square full-bleed film packaging cover for an iPhone film camera app.
Input image 1 is the current cover / edit target: preserve the recognizable historical stock identity, exact product name, characteristic typography, package motifs and palette family. Additional official images are identity/palette reference only. Last image (ASTIA) is the approved style reference: follow its bold flat front-panel packaging, large readable product name and decisive color blocks.
Primary request: redesign the current cover to emphasize its own existing stock-identification color rather than an almost entirely green background. This is a researched app adaptation, not an untouched facsimile. Rebalance the color-area proportions, typography hierarchy and label geometry into a premium cohesive family. Retain a small Fujifilm green brand header (about 15-20% of height) but make the stock's distinctive colors occupy the rest.
Composition: ONE 1:1 square, entire canvas filled edge to edge, orthographic flat printed front panel. All text fully inside a 5% safe margin, product name clearly readable at a 110-pixel thumbnail. Main title large and intentional, secondary technical text very small at bottom right. Fine, subtle matte ink/paper grain, crisp edges, saturated confident colors.
Constraints: no box sides, 3D perspective, photograph, scene, film cartridge, outer margin, border, rounded corners, glow, mockup shadows, extra decorations. No JustShoot, no RAW, no sRGB, no arrows, no marketing slogans, no generated-image watermark. Do not add any text except the specified text. Do not use a uniform green field as the main background. Keep original packaging character.
Stock: FUJICHROME PROVIA 100F. Expand the existing deep royal-blue / cobalt label into the dominant large middle/lower field (about 55% of area). Preserve the black Professional ribbon, thin gold rules and large cream-gold high-contrast PROVIA serif lettering inspired by the existing package. Green is just the upper brand band; a near-black band grounds the lower part (about 15%). Blue, gold, black and cream must be the immediate impression. Separate large PROVIA and 100F if needed for readability, never squeeze the full name into a tiny line.
Text verbatim: "FUJIFILM", "FUJICHROME", "PROVIA", "Professional", "100F", "DAYLIGHT", "35mm-36EXP", "ISO 100 · E-6".
